liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spoonful** (2 reviews): Reviewer found it wonderful; Fun, featuring Bobby's raspy screams [13][16]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Jerry hit every note all the way through; Reviewer calls it awesome, helped by Jerry and Phil picking up the slack [12][13]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer votes it the best of 1993, with Buckeye a close second [15]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer hears a soulful Jerry vocal and praises Vince's piano solo [15]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Reviewer says Garcia nails the solos while the band keeps good tempo [15]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Filled with Garcia's playful 'Yeah' interjections, with Phil's bass line solid [16]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Jerry played accurately throughout, and the transition into Fire was so smooth it was easy to miss [10]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer says Bobby struggled during Scarlet and missed most of Fire, with Jerry and Phil covering [13]

## The recordings

- **gd93-06-21.sbd.braverman.14121.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 4.07/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard's sound quality very good; Reviewer likes the mix of fuzz and raunch in Garcia's guitar tone during the first set [12][16]
- **gd1993-06-21.154456.senn441.greenberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd93-06-21.ST250s.nawrocki.13305.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1993-06-21.sbd.miller.108982.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 2.2/5 by 5 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer ran into two friends from the 81 MSA show in the parking lot [14]
- Reviewer's first Deer Creek; the night before, at a nearby campground, friendly strangers handed them about eight blotter hits [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-06-21.sbd.braverman.14121.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD: DAT> CD> SHN [1]. Also: Soundboard source went DAT to CD to SHN, seeded by Peter Braverman [1]
- **gd1993-06-21.154456.senn441.greenberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jason Greenberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jason Greenberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Marantz PMD430 [3]. Also: Mr. Darby's AKG 451 source supplies the crowd and start of Jack Straw, plus two patches in Drums [3]
- **gd93-06-21.ST250s.nawrocki.13305.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Pete Delgado; source: Audience: AMS ST-250 [6]. Also: Audience recording by Clay C. Brennecke and James Young: AMS ST-250 mics in Blumlein pattern, about six feet up on a light stand, into a modified Sony DAT [11]
- **gd1993-06-21.sbd.miller.108982.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat Master (48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-06-21 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-06-21-grateful-dead-ticket/) [23]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Deer Creek Music Center - June 21, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-21-1993) [24]
